Maya (docs): FYI opened a small PR to adjust the "console presets" docs and tracing-hook example for KV-cached dashboards. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999
Raj (eng-runtime): nice. what's the user-facing change?
Maya (docs): two things: 1) the JS snippet uses `includeCost` instead of the old `include_cost_breakdown` flag; 2) the example shows how prefix grouping affects top-level cost attribution and when you should add a sampled per-key span.
Lila (devex): can you paste the JS sample here so i can run it in the playground? aim to capture the network tab and the compact trace view.
Maya (docs): pasted below (JS):
```js
// fetch dashboard metrics with cost breakdown
const resp = await client.fetchDashboard({
  dashboardId: 'kv-cache-overview',
  filters: { 'kv.key_prefix': 'session/' },
  includeCost: true,
  limit: 50
});
console.log(resp.metrics);
```
Tom (sdk): heads-up: SDK v0.18 renamed the param to `includeCost`, but the Go and Java examples in the repo still use the old name. i'll prepare a micro PR to sync those.
Raj (eng-runtime): on the attribution text, suggest: "Prefix-grouping aggregates cost and latency by the prefix value. Exact-key telemetry will show per-key attribution. If your workload yields a small set of prefixes with large per-key variance, enable sampled per-key traces to surface outliers."
Maya (docs): good wording, i'll add that to the "what this means" section.
Nora (product): please also add a note in the migration guide: older SDKs exported `kv_prefix` (flat) while new ones emit `kv.key_prefix` (namespaced). mention the auto-backfill behavior in the console (unknown bucket).
Maya (docs): added compatibility note and a tiny migration snippet to transform old exports: 
```bash
# migration: convert flat kv_prefix to namespaced kv.key_prefix in export
jq '.events[] |= ( . + { "kv.key_prefix": .kv_prefix } )' old-export.json > new-export.json
```
Lila (devex): ran the JS sample in the playground, screenshots attached in the PR. small UI quirk: when the prefix filter is empty the preview shows collapsed groups; added a sentence "Empty prefix filter = show all groups (collapsed)".
Tom (sdk): opened SDK sync PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/299 — updates Go/Java/ts snippets and the changelog.
ci-bot: docs preview build OK: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/4999 (sha: abc123)
Raj (eng-runtime): one nit: in the metrics examples we used `token_cost_usd`; update to `cost_per_token_usd` to match telemetry naming.
Maya (docs): changed metric names and pushed.
Nora (product): approved copy; doc now mentions cost budgeting recommendation (group by prefix, sample keys for outliers).
Lila (devex): approve when SDK PR lands and preview updates the embedded snippets.
Tom (sdk): i'll merge the SDK PR in ~30m and ping here.
Maya (docs): thanks all — will merge once SDK PR is merged and preview shows synced snippets. planning to include this in the next docs patch release.
thread_summary: Coordination thread for updating console presets and tracing-hook examples to reflect JS SDK flag rename, KV prefix compatibility, and migration snippet.
